response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems; their C++ exposure is limited to a brief academic thesis and NI LabWindows™/CVI work over a decade ago, with no evidence of modern C++/STL, multi-threading, message brokers, or IEC 62443 security practices required for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across diverse technologies
Proven ability to lead open-source projects and mentor teams through workshops and code practices
Demonstrated expertise in event-driven systems, distributed architectures, and DevOps infrastructure
concerns: No recent or substantial C++/STL work in industrial or embedded contexts
Lacks documented experience with MQTT, REST in IoT, or industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443)
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, with minimal alignment to core C++ requirements
